response.overview: From Cameron Francis, director of last year’s FrightFest acclaimed breakout hit, COVER. Secrets... Lies... Bodies... Nothing stays buried forever. While visiting her best friend, a woman starts to question reality when she's confronted by seemingly supernatural events. As her sanity unravels, she comes to the terrifying realization that she might not survive the night. Set in one location, but given an epic look in John Carpenter-inspired wide-screen, claustrophobia, both mentally and physically, is the overwhelming mood of Francis’ latest miniature gem exploring the universal themes of regret, remorse and ultimately searching for forgiveness.
response.title: Blood Secret
